extras.units: centimetres in bind space (+Z up, +Y forward); the Character node scales to metres
extras.note: _MAT per vertex = (colour slot, roughness, metalness, flags) exactly as modules/skins.js aMat (flags 2 pattern, 4 emblem, 8 costume surface). _SLOT = colour slot. COLOR_0 = baked default colours. Skeleton, joint order and inverse bind matrices are the standard soldier's; hitboxes are NOT part of the skin (use the standard soldier hit shapes).
